items.title: Jupiter Launches Lend v2 on Solana, Letting Borrowed Assets Earn Trading Fees
items.whyYouShouldCare: Jupiter's Lend v2 enhances liquidity on Solana by allowing borrowed assets to generate trading fees, potentially increasing user engagement and platform utility.

items.title: Jito Finance’s on-chain strength lifts JTO: But Spot sellers oppose the move
items.whyYouShouldCare: Jito Finance's on-chain performance boosts JTO's value, but resistance from spot sellers may impact its upward momentum and overall market sentiment.

items.title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
items.whyYouShouldCare: The introduction of the Strategy STRC product by Solstice Finance diversifies offerings on Solana, which could attract new users and enhance ecosystem growth.
